bio: I’m Shehan, a Sri Lankan creative professional based in Italy. I work as a creative developer and multidisciplinary digital designer, and Lankio Digital Solutions is my independent studio.

My professional experience spans web development, web design, graphic design, photography, videography, video editing, 2D animation, motion graphics, social media marketing and SEO. Working across all of them means a website, a visual identity and a campaign film can grow from the same idea and stay consistent.
I also have professional experience in tourism and hold the IATA Foundation Diploma, which gives me a practical understanding of travel and hospitality businesses.

approach.title: Understand before designing
approach.body: Every project starts with the people it’s for and what they need to do. The visuals follow from that, not the other way round.

approach.title: Design and build as one
approach.body: Designing and building it myself means nothing is lost in a handover. The detail you approve is the detail that ships.

approach.title: Craft the small things
approach.body: Typography, motion, alt text and load times are the details people feel even when they don’t notice them.

approach.title: Talk plainly
approach.body: You work directly with me, with clear updates and honest advice about what is and isn’t worth doing.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what personal data lankio.it collects, why, and what rights you have under the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

sections.title: Data controller
sections.body: The data controller is Shehan Janith Hettiarachchi, operating as Lankio Digital Solutions, Italy. Contact: info@lankio.it.

sections.title: Contact form
sections.body: When you send an inquiry, the website processes your name, email address, optional company name, the type of project, optional timeline, preferred reply language and your message. This data is used only to reply to you and, if you choose to work together, to prepare a proposal (legal basis: pre-contractual steps at your request, Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR).

sections.title: Email delivery
sections.body: Messages are delivered by email through Resend, a transactional email provider acting as a data processor. Your message is sent to the studio’s inbox and a confirmation is sent to the address you provide. Inquiry emails are kept only as long as needed to handle your request and any resulting working relationship.

sections.title: Analytics
sections.body: With your consent, the website uses Google Analytics 4 to understand in aggregate how pages are used, for example which pages are visited and from which country. Google Analytics processes data such as your IP address and device information and sets cookies. It is loaded only after you accept analytics in the cookie banner (legal basis: consent, Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR), with Google Signals and ad personalisation turned off. You can withdraw consent at any time from “Cookie settings”; withdrawal does not affect processing carried out before it.

sections.title: Hosting and server logs
sections.body: The website is hosted on Vercel. Like any web server, the hosting infrastructure processes technical data such as IP addresses in server logs to deliver pages and keep the service secure (legitimate interest, Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).

sections.title: International transfers
sections.body: Some providers may process data outside the European Economic Area. Where this happens, transfers rely on safeguards recognised by the GDPR, such as the EU–US Data Privacy Framework or Standard Contractual Clauses.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: You can ask to access, correct or delete your data, restrict or object to its processing, and receive it in a portable format. Write to info@lankio.it. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Italian data protection authority (Garante per la protezione dei dati personali).

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: This policy explains which cookies lankio.it uses, when they are set, and how you can change your choice.

sections.title: How consent works
sections.body: On your first visit a banner asks whether you allow analytics. Analytics cookies are set only if you choose “Accept” or switch analytics on in “Preferences”. Rejecting, or closing the banner, keeps them off, and the website works the same either way. Your choice is remembered for six months, after which you will be asked again.

sections.title: Technical cookies (no consent needed)
sections.body: lankio_consent stores your cookie choice and expires after six months. NEXT_LOCALE is a session cookie, set only when you view the site in a language different from your browser’s, so the site can keep showing your chosen language. Neither cookie is used to track you.

sections.title: Analytics cookies (only with your consent)
sections.body: If you accept analytics, Google Analytics 4 is loaded and sets the first-party cookies _ga and _ga_<ID>, which can last up to two years. They are used only for aggregated statistics about how the website is used. Google Signals and ad personalisation are turned off. Before you consent, no Google Analytics script is loaded and no request is sent to Google.

sections.title: Changing or withdrawing consent
sections.body: Use “Cookie settings” at the bottom of any page, or the button below, to change your choice at any time. If you withdraw consent, Google Analytics is disabled straight away and its cookies on this website are deleted. You can also block or delete cookies in your browser settings.

sections.title: Content and intellectual property
sections.body: Unless stated otherwise, the text, design, images and videos on this website belong to Lankio Digital Solutions or are used with permission. Project screenshots show work presented with the owner’s authorisation. Please don’t reuse this content without written permission.

sections.title: Information on this website
sections.body: Content is provided for general information about the studio and its work. It isn’t an offer, and any project is agreed separately in writing.

sections.title: External links
